data.name: Odessa
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek word 'odos', meaning way or road. In ancient Greece, this name was given to a goddess of the hearth, home, and childbirth. In the Bible, it refers to the port city on the Black Sea. The name Odessa has been used as a feminine given name since the 19th century.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the journey of life and the importance of home and hearth.
